title: Ancient truths,

cards.title: Living Upanishads
cards.body: Aham Brahmasmi and Tat Tvam Asi taught as living truths — ancient wisdom made practical for modern minds.

cards.title: Science meets spirit
cards.body: Meditation, prana and energy explained through biology, psychology and physiology — logic and self-inquiry, never blind belief.

cards.title: Demystifying kundalini
cards.body: Genuine awakening cannot be forced — it unfolds naturally through meditation, inner purification and sustained practice.

cards.title: True markers of growth
cards.body: Less fear, anger and anxiety; more compassion, awareness and wisdom — real change, not mystical display.

archSub: The heart generates a magnetic field ~100× stronger than the brain's — measurable up to 15 feet around the body. What you feel, you transmit.
staticBody: Fear and hurry make the heart rhythm jagged and the brain scattered — an incoherent signal that broadcasts, and attracts, more static.
coherentBody: A quiet heart broadcasts a smooth, organised wave. Like a tuning fork, a coherent field sets the space around it humming in sympathy.

principles.title: The observer
principles.body: Attention collapses possibility into experience — what you steadily watch, you make real.

principles.title: Entanglement
principles.body: Your field is never isolated — influence travels between hearts without physical contact.

principles.title: Resonance
principles.body: A coherent field attracts matching people, opportunities and events — like answers like.

protocol.title: Morning coherence
protocol.body: Before opening your eyes: 10 minutes of slow 5-second rhythmic breathing — set the day's frequency first.

protocol.title: Scan & interrupt
protocol.body: Catch static in real time. On tension, breathe 5-5-7 — the longer exhale calms the nervous system out of survival mode.

protocol.title: Feel it done
protocol.body: The field responds to feeling, not thought — gratitude in advance broadcasts the signal of a life already fulfilled.
